turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero from his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start by telling me who decided that, and when.
I don't think this is productive.
"Productive." You asked for this meeting, Hale, so answer my question: who entered that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
Then you have ten minutes, and I'm using them. Was Owen heard before the zero went in, yes or no? If you walk out without answering, I'm going straight to the principal's office.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.

I'm not emailing, Hale; I'm walking down the hall to the principal's office the minute you leave this room. I'm writing down that you refused to tell me whether Owen was heard before the zero went in. That zero comes off, and I want it in writing.
